## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 394 captures during March 2023. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for review of image quality and grading performance during the month.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 4.6. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that proceeded through the grading process. Image quality remained an important part of the operational review, particularly in assessing whether captured images were suitable for clinical assessment.

## Grading

A total of 98 captures were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 1. This indicates that the central tendency for the interval between capture and grading was short during the reporting period. The referable results and grading lag should be considered alongside the capture volume and the ungradable rate when reviewing site performance. Overall, the activity, image quality, and grading measures provide a concise summary of operations at Harbour Eye Clinic for March 2023.
